# Documentation governance fixtures

`v1/` freezes synthetic, provider-neutral inputs and expected read-only findings for
`documentation-governance-finding-v1`.

The corpus is intentionally small and artificial. It contains no project facts,
credentials, prompts, transcripts, or source code. Positive cases exercise one
rule at a time; their paired negative controls show that the same document role
can remain finding-free. The fixtures are contract evidence, not an audit runtime
and not authority evidence.
